headline: US Military Withdraws From Key Air Base in Somalia as Türkiye Eyes Site
summary: United States military personnel have vacated a strategic airfield in Somalia. Regional sources indicate Türkiye is considering taking over operations at the facility.
why: Horn of Africa air bases are critical strategic nodes for international trade security and anti-piracy maritime operations along Red Sea shipping routes.

impacts.name: Somalia
impacts.why: Shifts in foreign military footprint alter Horn of Africa security dynamics and trade route protection.
